snippet.title: The Greatest Thanksgiving Songs of All Time
snippet.description:
Enjoy a wonderful collection of classic Thanksgiving songs celebrating good food, family gatherings, friendship and giving thanks. This Thanksgiving music playlist brings together fun and nostalgic songs for Thanksgiving from decades past, with a relaxing background of vintage nostalgic postcards and greeting cards dating up to (and over) 100 years old!

Our classic Thanksgiving songs playlist features old Thanksgiving songs about turkeys, pumpkin pie, cornbread, good eating, Thanksgiving dinner and traveling home to visit family and friends. There's healthy servings of funny vintage food songs and oldies songs about Thanksgiving from the golden eras of music. This is clean, family friendly (and classroom friendly) Thanksgiving music for kids and grownups alike, with plenty of vintage charm and a few laughs along the way.

If you're looking for music for Thanksgiving dinner, a fun Thanksgiving songs playlist or some vintage holiday music to have playing around the house, tune in to our Thanksgiving music playlist while cooking the Thanksgiving feast, baking pumpkin pies, preparing the dinner table or spending time with family and friends. These classic Thanksgiving songs make a lovely background for Thanksgiving celebrations, whether you're busy in the kitchen or sitting down to enjoy a holiday meal.

Alongside the Thanksgiving music is a nostalgic collection of over 100 vintage Thanksgiving postcards and greeting cards, featuring charming illustrations of turkeys, autumn harvests, Thanksgiving dinners and holiday celebrations from decades past. The changing vintage Thanksgiving artwork creates a warm and calming Thanksgiving ambience, providing a soothing visual background to enjoy while listening to the music or simply leave playing throughout the holiday.

This Thanksgiving music radio mix is also suitable for the classroom, with fun Thanksgiving songs for kids, family friendly Thanksgiving music for school activities and nostalgic Thanksgiving favorites for autumn celebrations. From funny turkey songs and cheerful songs about food to sentimental Thanksgiving oldies, this vintage holiday music playlist has something for children, parents and grandparents to enjoy together.

Whether you're searching for classic Thanksgiving music, old Thanksgiving songs, Thanksgiving dinner background music, fun songs for Thanksgiving or a Thanksgiving radio station, you're welcome to leave this Thanksgiving music playlist playing throughout the day. A little silly at times, a little sentimental and filled with old fashioned holiday charm, it's a cheerful way to enjoy the sounds and sights of Thanksgiving.
